title: アカデミックライティング
subtitle: Academic Writing
teachers:
MIYAZATO Shinichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) understand the essence of civil and environmental engineering.
(2) gain skills for producing reports that relate to civil and environmental engineering.
advice:
This is a basic course on describing papers. We will cover the following materials:

1. Problem discovery skills
2. Information gathering, analysis, and arrangement skills
3. Problem-solving ability
4. Report writing skills
5. Quotation skills

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class.

These skills are useful in all subjects. Additionally, they are valuable preparation for entrance examinations for graduate school and for preparing resumes and applications when job hunting.
books: How to write a paper or report for university students, ISBN978-4-7806-1235-6
requiredKnowledge:
Reading and writing in Japanese.
Using library and Internet.

(1) Fully understanding the report writing process including information gathering, reference literature, content outline, elaboration and appearance.
(2)  Appropriately explaining a report, including one's own philosophy.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Knowing the report writing process including information gathering, reference literature, content outline, elaboration and appearance.
(2) Describing a report while defending copyrighting.
